sourceRead: Every complete source body and manifest was read from primary Git custody. The 89,373-byte carrier was parsed and each embedded asset independently hashed; Unicode UTF-8 byte counts are distinct from character counts.
decision: No material source blocker to the root-owned positive installation under exact external source/runtime admission and independent complete native inventory.

findings.evidence: install.main checks the new absolute destination, ordinary existing parents and parent UID, then calls read_regular/admit_payload, reads all six source files, checks exact source-carrier equality and fixed release, validates the template placeholder and compiles the opener before destination.mkdir.

The carrier's entire byte length/SHA256 and fixed schema/source commit/tree are checked. Each of exactly three fixed paths has independently fixed bytes/SHA256/Git blob; duplicate JSON fields, duplicate/unexpected asset paths and incomplete membership are refused. Encoding the carrier's string values yields bytes identical to the original qualified asset pins.

Source reads use bounded sizes, lstat type checks on files and parent chain, O_NOFOLLOW, opened file identity and before/after consistency. Destination files use O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW, fchmod, flush and fsync. Existing destination is refused before reading/copying source. A partial new folder is retained.

All13 intended installed files are copied exclusively and read back byte-identical with exact mode. INSTALLATION.json is the last write, with the location, source/payload/release/runtime record and file inventory. No recovery replacement or deletion branch is present.

open.verify reads the marker first, admits its release/location/inventory fields, verifies all13 recorded regular files and fixed release/carrier identities, then independently verifies all three original assets. main invokes /usr/bin/open only after verify returns. Missing marker or changed asset follows the nonzero refusal branch before dispatch.

The fixed /bin/zsh template quotes its own directory, substitutes exactly one shlex-quoted existing sys.executable, then execs that Python with -B and installed open.py plus original arguments. --check and --no-open are mutually exclusive, verify first, and skip desktop dispatch. File URI comes from pathlib.as_uri for the exact installed HTML.

The normal Mac branch calls subprocess.run with literal /usr/bin/open and one verified file URL, shell=False by default, discarded child streams and10s timeout. The author control will record this intent under a dispatch spy; it will not invoke the real opener or claim desktop/browser behavior.
The helper adds installation/entry/recovery behavior only. It introduces no runtime/dependency install, server, product port, service, automatic persistence or app/math change.

qualifications: RELEASE.json fixes the original product asset identities. It does not independently anchor helper/launcher source. Those identities are bound by the separately read six-file source index and root's exact native source/installed manifests. A self-consistent modified local marker alone is not independent source proof.

open.verify validates the13 declared files but does not enumerate and reject extra directory entries. Foundation confirms its independent receiver enumerates exactly14 actual files including the marker and compares every expected path/type/mode/byte/hash/Git identity before and after use.
No host call, actual installation, negative-control execution, installed shebang execution or browser use was performed by this reviewer during source review.
Review accepts the operation under the root's current identity/resource and exact source admission. It does not extend that admission to another installation, runtime, user, directory or query owner.
